title: Ruleset v12 landed without the fixtures, so every cassette was refused and CI went red
foundBy: session agent, investigating a report that the GitHub CI build is broken

evidence.verified: `./bin/cs-vcr cassette verify` reports all eight cassettes ok and exits 0, where it exited 4 naming 21 stale entries. `make test-smoke` replays all eight fixtures against Claude Code 2.1.232, Codex 0.148.0 and OpenCode 1.18.11 in 17.6s, all PASS. `./bin/cs-vcr cassette scrub` reports all eight clean, and `make check` exits 0.

details:
`d3b0e62` added `<skills_instructions>` to the drop list and took the ruleset to v12 without re-recording. The eight committed cassettes all still read `normalize_version: 11`, and a cassette whose ruleset is not the build's is refused by name, so no fixture replayed.

Two CI jobs failed on it. `cassette verify` exited 4 reporting 21 stale entries across all eight cassettes, and `integration` failed every subtest of `TestReplayFixtures` with the same version mismatch.

This is the second time the ruleset has moved without the fixtures following it; VCR-010 was the same defect across four commits. CONTRIBUTING requires the bump and the re-recording in one pull request, and nothing enforces that locally before a push.

The remedy taken was a renormalization rather than a re-recording. Every committed request body is the canonical form the recorder hashed, which was confirmed by normalizing each one under v11 and finding it byte-identical with a hash matching its index line. v12 differs from v11 only by dropping a whole list item, so normalizing the committed bodies under v12 produces exactly what a recording under v12 would have written. Four Codex requests lost their skills list, 2826 bytes each; the other seventeen entries were unchanged.

notes.text: `make fixtures` was not an option on the host that fixed this: it has an OpenAI and a Fireworks key but no Anthropic key, and the Claude Pro/Max and ChatGPT scenarios need interactive logins. A partial recording run would have left at least three cassettes at v11 and CI still red.
